Description

Xplore will utilize OrbAstro's satellite buses for a variety of innovative missions, beginning with OrbAstro's ORB-6 platform. Xplore will fly novel Earth and astronomical observation imagers, with a first launch scheduled for late 2022.
Notes

NB! Unclear about the satellite size and mission. These were already in the database and were originally scheduled for 2022. CelesTrak has these OrbAstro TC1 and PC1 satellites separately, but SpaceX has only listed OrbAstro-TR1. Will need to ask personally.
